Abdoulaye Seck.note: Seck is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward.
Abdoulaye Seck.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。

Antoine Mendy.note: Watch Mendy for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Antoine Mendy.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Assane Diao.note: Diao's edge is explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Assane Diao.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Bamba Dieng.note: Dieng's edge is explosive speed once open grass appears. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Bamba Dieng.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Bara Sapoko Ndiaye.summary: Bara Sapoko Ndiaye is a Senegal central midfielder from Bayern Munich who gives the national team youthful ball carrying, midfield mobility, and long-term upside.
Bara Sapoko Ndiaye.note: Ndiaye is defined by changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Bara Sapoko Ndiaye.noteZh: 他靠变向时仍把球控制在脚下与同位置球员拉开差异。他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Cherif Ndiaye.note: Watch Ndiaye for making the next teammate's action easier. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Cherif Ndiaye.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是让队友下一步处理更轻松。留意他如何把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Edouard Mendy.note: Mendy's signature is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk.
Edouard Mendy.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在危险出现前组织好队友上。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

El Hadji Malick Diouf.note: Diouf is defined by making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
El Hadji Malick Diouf.noteZh: 他靠在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Habib Diarra.note: Diarra's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Habib Diarra.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Ibrahim Mbaye.note: Mbaye's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Ibrahim Mbaye.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Idrissa Gueye.note: Gueye is defined by moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over.
Idrissa Gueye.noteZh: 他靠用传球的力度和角度移动防线与同位置球员拉开差异。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会第一次争抢还没结束，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。

Iliman Ndiaye.note: Ndiaye is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Iliman Ndiaye.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Ismail Jakobs.note: Watch Jakobs for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Ismail Jakobs.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是防线暴露后的回追速度。留意他如何等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Ismaila Sarr.note: Sarr's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Ismaila Sarr.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Kalidou Koulibaly.note: Koulibaly's signature is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Kalidou Koulibaly.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在危险出现前组织好队友上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Krepin Diatta.note: Diatta stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Krepin Diatta.noteZh: 他的突出特点是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Lamine Camara.note: Camara is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Lamine Camara.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Mamadou Sarr.note: Watch Sarr for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Mamadou Sarr.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。留意他如何提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Mory Diaw.note: Diaw's edge is staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Mory Diaw.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Moussa Niakhate.note: Niakhaté's edge is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Moussa Niakhate.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Nicolas Jackson.note: Watch Jackson for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Nicolas Jackson.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Pape Gueye.note: Gueye's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Pape Gueye.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Pape Matar Sarr.note: Sarr stands out for creating a better angle for the next pass. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Pape Matar Sarr.noteZh: 他的突出特点是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Pathe Ciss.note: Ciss is defined by choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Pathe Ciss.noteZh: 他靠选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Sadio Mane.note: Mané is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Sadio Mane.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Yehvann Diouf.note: Diouf stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Yehvann Diouf.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。
